_about: Corpus for scripts/checker-truth-check.mjs (plan item 13). Made-up data and generic labels only. For each script, `elements` names the claim that owns the comparison of each text element the REAL figure draws (from scripts/truth/mpl_truth.py): C = control (the size comes from plt.rcParams['font.size'] or its update() dict form, or from ax.set_xlabel/set_ylabel/set_title(fontsize=) and ax.tick_params(labelsize=), all of which the checker is meant to read; must agree or the run exits 2), T = tick labels inheriting font.size (the 0.83x multiplier), W2 = a per-element rcParams key, SA = the rcParams alias (mpl.rcParams, from matplotlib import rcParams), SR = plt.rc(), SK = a fontsize= keyword the parser does not read, SK2 = a further keyword idiom (size=, fontdict=, a named size in fontsize=/labelsize=, legend(prop=), Text.set_fontsize), READTIME = an rcParams key set after the figure exists, G = Postr's own generated code (charts/codegen/toPython.ts) sets it through a variable. '-' = drawn but not scored (a mismatch there would be confounded by another claim, or belongs to another plan item). `what` says what the script exercises; it is documentation, not an input to the scoring. A script with `generated` is not a file here: the harness generates it at run time through the app's own module (`generated.module`, export `generated.export`) from `generated.spec`, so it always matches the shipped generator. `scaleClaim` names the claim that owns the scale comparison: C (the default, a control), G (G-scale: the canvas is set through variables), CANVAS (the canvas is not a literal figsize), '-' (not scored). `expect` makes the script a known answer (control K-known) for the claims it names: {claim: {observed, ofAtLeast}} - the claim's own comparison must observe exactly `observed` of at least `ofAtLeast`, and the script is kept out of that claim's k of n. Legend titles and Axes texts (claim AXTEXT), bbox_inches='tight' (TIGHT) and show() (SHOWSAVE) need no entry: the harness reads them from the real render. Part 2 (record 13 section 10; ids p2-*): VAR = a size held in a name (font.size or a fontsize= keyword), CTX = a size set by plt.rc_context around the figure; the claims SAVED (verdicts against the image savefig writes) and SNIPLOW / SNIPL (the page's 'Or change one number' font.size, applied as the user is told to) need no entry. Fix 13b review round 1 (ids r1-*, the reviewer's probe scripts that found defects; record docs/fixes/13b-checker-sizes.md section 9): owners R1-GRID, R1-FONTDICT, R1-TUPLE, R1-KW, R1-TIGHTDEF, R1-SNSPOS, R1-COND; the claim CUT (a text the original's image holds, cut from the corrected script's image) needs no entry. Fix 13b review round 2 (ids r2-*, the reviewer's scripts that found defects, and siblings; record section 9): owners R2-TITLELOC, R2-LOOP, R2-UNREAD, R2-PDF, R2-CBAR, R2-SUP, R2-ADVICE, R2-TIGHT. Fix 13b review round 3 (ids r3-*, the reviewer's scripts that found defects; record section 9): owners R3-RUN (P21's floor on a string font.size, the FontProperties import after `from __future__` and by its own name), R3-UNREAD (every drawn row resting on an unread size floored).
